root_cause.primary: PyTorch dynamic quantization was applied only to Linear layers, while IResNet50/ResNet50 ArcFace inference is dominated by Conv2d blocks.
secondary: The expensive convolutional backbone stayed FP32.
LFW latency includes image decoding, preprocessing, batching, embedding normalization, and pair scoring.
Dynamic INT8 Linear layers may add quantize/dequantize overhead on CPU.
ONNX Runtime speedup comes from graph and kernel optimization rather than weight compression.

recommended_next_steps: Rerun Task6 on the final LFW-qualified Task5 checkpoint.
Prefer ONNX Runtime or TensorRT FP16 for deployment latency.
Use static INT8 or QAT with Conv2d calibration if true INT8 acceleration is required.
Consider structured pruning or distillation to MobileFaceNet for larger latency reduction.
